# Echonomix Inc.

> Echonomix Inc. is a U.S.-based educational technology company creating the world's first NFC-Ready learning blockchain board game. The Founder's Edition Smart-Board (Patent Pending) connects phones and tablets via NFC to layered educational content about Bitcoin, Ethereum, staking, and Web3. Founded by Noel Segui in Northeast Pennsylvania (NEPA / Scranton, PA, USA).

Echonomix combines a physical Monopoly-style board with NFC tap-to-learn mechanics. Property cards become Web3 walkthroughs. Currency teaches denomination, supply, and Bitcoin halving cycles. Tokens represent live cryptocurrency assets. The Smart-Board layers educational lessons through phone or tablet NFC taps.

The company was founded by Noel Segui, who began as a Bitcoin miner in a Scranton, PA loft in 2017–2018, sold mining hardware on eBay (Bitmain Antminer S9), and pivoted to long-term crypto investing and educational product development.

Status: Pre-launch. Notify list at noel@solarmason.com.

## About the founder

Noel Segui — U.S. veteran, operating engineer, founder of Echonomix Inc., owner-operator of Solar Mason LLC (solar EPC) and NEPA-PRO (property maintenance and construction). Based in Clarks Summit, PA. Began crypto journey mining Bitcoin in a Scranton loft and selling Bitmain Antminer S9 mining units on eBay. Holds a long-term portfolio of crypto and is bringing educational blockchain content to the next generation through the Echonomix Founder's Edition Smart-Board.
